change_summary: Phase 24: the first subject-matter science. Adds three new subjects, each with its own course and an introductory unit - Physics (motion, forces and energy: speed, acceleration, mass and weight, Newton's laws, density, work and power, energy stores, waves), Chemistry (matter, atoms and reactions: states of matter, atomic structure, elements and compounds, the periodic table, formulas, balancing equations, conservation of mass, acids and bases) and Biology (cells, genetics and ecosystems: life processes, cells, levels of organisation, photosynthesis and respiration, DNA and genes, inheritance, cell division, energy flow). 24 skills and 192 questions, all graded by the existing deterministic validators.
